posts.text: · 23. oktober. Av nyhetssak den 2. okt kl. 19.00: "This announcement constitutes the settlement notification pursuant to section 3.11 "Settlement of the Offer" of the Offer Document. Settlement of the Offer shall take place pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Offer Document and is currently expected to take place on or about 23 October 2026 and will be made to shareholders of Elmera having validly accepted the Offer in accordance with the terms as set out in Offer Document. Settlement of the Offer is subject to the other Closing Conditions set out in Section 3.4 "Conditions for completion of the Offer" of the Offer Document (as defined and described in the Offer Document) continuing to be satisfied until settlement of the Offer or being waived by the Offeror in its sole discretion. "
